name: action-guard
description: Refuses, or asks about, actions against one web application the agent works with: writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) unless the path allows them, protected paths with any method, requests from code whose method cannot be read, form input, JavaScript and uploads in a browser tab that is on the application, and listed tools of the application's MCP server. A PreToolUse hook on Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch and every MCP tool; the policy is a JSON file.
